quests.desc: Get ready to pick stuff up and put it in places, because you've just entered TextWorld! First thing I need you to do is to attempt to take a trip south. And then, make an effort to head south. Then, make an effort to go east. Following that, go to the north. And then, go to the east. Then, attempt to take a trip north. Then, make an attempt to head east. Once you get around to doing that, travel south. With that over with, make an effort to go to the south. And then, go south. Once you accomplish that, lift the mop from the floor of the laundry place. Alright, thanks!

objective: Hey, thanks for coming over to the TextWorld today, there is something I need you to do for me. First off, if it's not too much trouble, I need you to travel south. With that done, head south. After that, make an effort to travel east. With that done, venture north. If you can accomplish that, venture east. With that accomplished, head north. Okay, and then, make an effort to take a trip east. And then, make an effort to venture south. Okay, and then, try to travel south. With that over with, take a trip south. Once you do that, pick-up the mop from the floor of the laundry place. And once you've done that, you win!
